_help: Copy to models.json. Each entry points at a model folder or a Hugging Face repo. Only list what you have trained.

luo._note: Folder saved by ml/train_asr.ipynb (or e.g. "jeotamedia/whisper-small-luo"). language_token: see the notebook's WHISPER_LANGUAGE.

_example_en->luo._note: Keys are "source->target" in Ndimi codes; "*->luo" matches any source. Remove the leading _ to switch an entry on.

_example_luo._note: Any Hugging Face text-to-speech model (e.g. a VITS/MMS voice fine-tuned on your recordings). Remove the leading _ to switch it on.
